Author: Chief Justice Bench: Chief Justice  1  IN THE HIGH COURT OF MADHYA PRADESH  AT JABALPUR  CRA No. 9410 of 2023  (MANOJ VERMA Vs THE STATE OF MADHYA PRADESH AND OTHERS)
Dated : 16-04-2024  Shri R.K. Tripathi - Advocate for appellant.

entities.text: HIGH COURT OF MADHYA PRADESH  AT JABALPUR
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Shri A.S. Baghel - Public Prosecutor for respondents.
This is an application filed on behalf of accused-appellant for suspension of sentence and grant of bail.

T h e accused has been convicted for the offence punishable under Sections 363, 366-A and 376(1)(2)(n) of the IPC read with Section 5(L)/6 of the POCSO Act and sentenced to undergo R.I. for five years, seven years and for life and to pay fine of Rs.500/-, 500/- and 1000/- respectively with default stipulations vide judgment of conviction and order of sentence dated 12.06.2023 passed by the Additional Sessions Judge, Chourai, District Chhindwara in S.C. No. 06 of 2021.
The case of the prosecution is that the appellant took away the victim and had committed a forcible offence upon her punishable under Section 376(1)(2)
(n) of the IPC.

entities.text: Additional Sessions Judge, Chourai, District Chhindwara
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: The victim thereafter states that after a period of two months she realized that the offence has been committed and the complaint was lodged.
There is no explanation as to the conduct of the appellant for the said period of two months.
It is apparent that she could have stayed with the appellant on her own will for the aforesaid period.

Prima facie, we are of the view that based on the material produced by the prosecution itself, the appellant is entitled to be released on bail on the ground that the victim has spent almost two months with the appellant.

Accordingly, appellant - Manoj Verma is directed to be enlarged on bail, subject to he depositing the fine amount and on furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with one solvent surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court for his appearance before the trial Court/concerned Court on 05.08.2024 and thereafter on such other subsequent dates as may be fixed in that behalf.
